fields.label: Anchor
fields.text: Theorem 1, eqs.(7)-(10), main text PDF p.5-6; lambda and O(theta) defined in Table 5 items 2-3 (online table 5); assumptions Table 6 A-G; proof Supplementary Note VII

fields.label: Statement summary
fields.text: Consider constraints (7) and define f by (8)-(9). There exist parameters satisfying (7) for which f > 0. For these parameters, QT1 and QT2 are eps_unf-unforgeable with (10).

fields.label: Variables
fields.text:
N: number of quantum states (pulses) Bob sends Alice
n: '|Lambda|, number of states Alice reports as successfully measured'
P_det: probability that a state transmitted by Bob is reported by Alice as successfully measured
gamma_det: agreed minimum detection rate; Bob aborts unless n >= gamma_det N (Table 2 step 2)
gamma_err: agreed maximum error rate; B_b validates iff d(x_b, r_b) <= |Delta_b| gamma_err (step 12)
E: Alice's error probability when measuring in Bob's preparation basis; E = max_{t,u} E_tu
beta_PB: 'bias of Bob''s preparation-basis distribution: 1/2 - beta_PB <= P^k_PB(u) <= 1/2 + beta_PB,
  0 < beta_PB < 1/2'
beta_PS: 'bias of Bob''s preparation-state distribution: 1/2 - beta_PS <= P^k_PS(t) <= 1/2 + beta_PS'
beta_E: 'bias of Alice''s bit z: 1/2 - beta_E <= P_E(z) <= 1/2 + beta_E'
P_noqub: 'probability that a prepared state has dimension > 2 (photonic: multi-photon pulse); Poisson
  source P_noqub = 1-(1+mu)e^{-mu}'
theta: uncertainty angle on the Bloch sphere of Bob's bases relative to computational/Hadamard, theta
  in (0, pi/4); also absorbs Alice's measurement misalignment (Table 5 item 5)
O_theta: O(theta) = (cos theta + sin theta)/sqrt2; |<phi_t0|phi_t'1>| <= O(theta) (Table 5 item 2)
lambda: lambda(theta, beta_PB) = (1/2)(1 - sqrt(1 - [1 - O(theta)^2](1 - 4 beta_PB^2))) (Table 5 item
  3); 0 < lambda < (1/2)(1 - 1/sqrt2)
nu_cor: free mathematical variable chosen by Alice in Lemma 3
nu_unf: free mathematical variable chosen by Bob in Theorem 1
M: 2^M presentation points (Theorem 2)
C: number of pairs of spacelike-separated presentation points (Theorem 2)

fields.label: Assumptions table6
fields.text:
A: Bob prepares each qubit state from exactly two orthonormal qubit bases
B: t and u generated with exactly product distributions (no correlations)
C: Lambda gives Bob no information about W and z
D: 'QT1: conditioned on k in Lambda, Alice''s basis is uniform (P_MB = 1/2)'
E: Bob cannot use un-agreed degrees of freedom to affect/learn Alice's measurement statistics (no side
  channels)
F: 'photonic: Alice''s detectors have equal efficiency eta, dark counts with (1-d0)(1-d1) = (1-d+)(1-d-),
  independent'
G: 'photonic: from Alice''s perspective Bob''s pulses are Fock-state mixtures (phase randomised)'

fields.label: Allowed imperfections table5
fields.text: items 1-8: multi-photon/non-qubit states (P_noqub); basis uncertainty theta; biases beta_PS, beta_PB; losses (Lambda, gamma_det); arbitrary pair of measurement bases D0, D1; measurement errors (gamma_err); bias beta_E; threshold detectors with dark counts

fields.label: Quantifier over adversaries
fields.text: dishonest Alice, arbitrary quantum strategy; only possible restriction is indirect, through assumption G (Discussion, PDF p.7)

fields.label: Out of domain rule
fields.text: If (7) fails or f <= 0, the theorem gives no bound. The QMint status must be UNCERTIFIED and must not be extrapolated.

fields.label: Lane a sanity check
fields.text: RECOMPUTED_BY_LANE_A: with mu=0.09 (P_noqub=0.0038150) and N=4e7, the first term of (10) reaches 5e-10 at nu_unf ~ 3.89e-3, which matches the reported 3.9e-3 'minimum value' after rounding. At theta=5 deg, beta=2.3e-4 and gamma_err just above E=0.03, f is about 1.8e-5 > 0, which agrees with the Fig.5 region. This is a consistency check of the transcription, not a reproduction of Fig.5.
